blocks.html: Autonomous cleaning robots designed to maintain clean, safe, and professional environments with minimal human intervention. From sweeping and scrubbing to vacuuming and floor maintenance, our intelligent cleaning solutions improve operational efficiency while delivering consistent cleaning performance across commercial facilities.

items.title: Intelligent Navigation
text: Advanced LiDAR and vision-based navigation allow robots to safely operate around people, furniture, and changing environments.

items.title: Autonomous Cleaning
text: Perform sweeping, vacuuming, scrubbing, and floor maintenance with minimal operator involvement for consistent daily cleaning.

items.title: Multi-Surface Performance
text: Designed to clean a variety of commercial floor types while maintaining consistent cleaning quality throughout the facility.

items.title: Smart Fleet Management
text: Monitor cleaning progress, schedule tasks, and manage one or multiple robots through a centralized management platform.

blocks.html: Smarter Facility Maintenance Through Intelligent Automation

Autonomous cleaning robots help organizations maintain cleaner facilities while reducing repetitive manual tasks and improving operational efficiency. Designed for commercial environments, these robots perform scheduled cleaning routines with consistent performance, allowing facility teams to focus on higher-value responsibilities.

With intelligent navigation, automated task scheduling, and centralized fleet management, robotic cleaning solutions provide reliable floor maintenance across a wide range of indoor environments.

items: Operate during and after business hours compartments

blocks.html: The KLEENBOT C40 is one of the flagship autonomous cleaning robots within our commercial cleaning portfolio. Designed for professional indoor environments, it combines sweeping, vacuuming, scrubbing, and drying capabilities with intelligent navigation and cloud-based management to deliver efficient and reliable cleaning operations. It also features a triple-brush dry-wet separation system, fast-drying performance, and quick battery replacement for continuous operation.
